name: principle-outcome-oriented-execution
purpose: Converge on the intended verifiable migration end state without retaining throwaway compatibility states.
triggers: Planned rewrites and migrations with explicit phase boundaries
inputs: Relevant source and available verification tools
outputs: Migration with declared reversible breakage boundaries, checks for touched areas and full static and runtime verification at completion, or an explicit reduced plan
ordinaryExample: Migrate a module to the agreed interface in phases, declare temporary caller breakage, check touched code during migration and verify the completed target after removing temporary adapters.
capabilityLimits: Source inspection, authorized writes and observed execution are required for full implementation and verification.
Missing writes or execution permit a reduced migration plan; missing source or target blocks grounded implementation.
Preserved disable-model-invocation metadata does not prove host enforcement.
Host behavior has not been tested.
